svg.title: Human–AI Developmental Process Architecture
svg.desc: The Human–AI Pathways Project. Original process relationships retained: developmental ecology; recursive participation and co-intelligence; microgenetic loop including recognition; longitudinal trajectory; developmental inference. See the adjacent caption for open theoretical questions.
svg.text: Toward a Design Science of Human–AI Developmental Ecologies
Studying development through the ecologies of participation that shape human capacities.
